## Think About It

1. Why do squirrels gather acorns? (To eat during the cold winter months.) 2. Why do some birds fly south? (To find warmer weather and food.) 3. Find Stage 4 Latin /sh/ PGs. (None in the story itself, but 'preparations' = pre+par+ation+s. Station has 'ti' → /sh/.)
